title: "Projects"

Projects are the build layer of Lunaland: reproducible workflows, statistical explainers and interactive tools.

## Featured projects

### [RNA-seq Workflow Demo](rnaseq-workflow.qmd)

A Nextflow workflow structure for RNA-seq preprocessing, and a DESeq2 analysis on simulated counts where I know which genes really changed.

**Code:** [rna-seq-demo](https://github.com/paola-arguello/rna-seq-demo)  

**Related concepts:** reproducibility, quality control, differential expression, workflow design  
**Related pitfalls:** [Batch Effects](../pitfalls/batch-effects.qmd), [Wrong Genome Build](../pitfalls/wrong-genome-build.qmd)  
**Related Crosswalk posts:** [When is a genetic association real?](../crosswalk/posts/genetic-association-real.qmd)  

---

### [When is a genetic association real? (Shiny app)](genetic-association.qmd)

An interactive app explaining odds ratios, confidence intervals and sample size in genetic association studies.

**Open the app:** [live on shinyapps.io](https://paola-arguello-pascualli.shinyapps.io/genetic-association-shiny/)  
**Code:** [genetic-association-shiny](https://github.com/paola-arguello/genetic-association-shiny)  
**Related concepts:** uncertainty, confidence intervals, effect size, statistical significance  
**Related pitfalls:** low counts and overinterpretation *(coming soon)*  
**Related Crosswalk posts:** [When is a genetic association real?](../crosswalk/posts/genetic-association-real.qmd)
